read.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 35% to Rs 4,904 Cr and operational EBIT up 26% to Rs 816 Cr, led by Chemicals and Films, with capacity additions (PVDF, Chemours, HFO) on schedule but no numeric capex or utilisation guidance.

utilisation.quote: Large integrated complexes running at high, record utilization

capex.quote: PVDF commissioning is on track for Q3 FY27 capitalization

triggers.label: Realisation improved, cost pass-through effective
triggers.quote: Margins remained healthy despite elevated raw-material, freight and fuel costs, supported by effective cost pass-through.

triggers.label: Films strong growth across all geographies
triggers.quote: Strong growth delivered across all geographies, despite a volatile operating environment.

triggers.label: US refrigerant demand softer
triggers.quote: Aggressive expansion in new markets helped offset softness in the US market.
